task_id_match.notes: All 51 task IDs match character-for-character between sop_modules.json and production.json. Sequential generation produced clean threading.

task_classification_match.notes: All 51 tasks have identical task_classification values between SOP and production.

uom_match.notes: All 51 tasks have identical unit_of_measure values between SOP and production.

material_system_threading.notes: 7 material systems defined. SOP primer tasks reference systems via substrate_material and substrate_state branching. Material systems cover all 3 substrate materials and all 3 substrate states.

task_prefix_check.notes: All 51 tasks use TSK_DRRP_ prefix. No collisions with existing prefixes.

qt_range.evidence: resolution.json applicable_enums.quality_tier.values = [QT3, QT4, QT5]. production.json qt_exclusion_notice.qt2_applicable = false. All qt_conditional tasks appear_in_tiers excludes QT2. QT2 excluded with documented rationale (doors are fine-finish substrate).

substrate_materials.evidence: SOP tasks branch by substrate_material via applies_when: TSK_DRRP_CLEAN_STEEL (steel), TSK_DRRP_CLEAN_FIBERGLASS (fiberglass), TSK_DRRP_CLEAN_WOOD (wood). Primer tasks branch similarly. Production rates match. Materials.json has substrate-specific primer systems.

substrate_states.evidence: resolution.json substrate_state.input_states = [SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT, SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT, SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST]. SOP tasks use substrate_state_rules to activate/skip based on state. SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST is steel-only per RC-001.

door_complexity.evidence: resolution.json door_complexity.values = [slab, panel, grand_entry]. FAC_DRRP_COMPLEXITY modifier: slab=1.00, panel=1.30, grand_entry=2.00. Glass masking conditional on panel/grand_entry.

hardware_removal_mandatory.evidence: TSK_DRRP_HARDWARE_REMOVE applies_when={} (unconditional). Research RF-003: 'Total removal of all locking hardware... masking hardware is discouraged.' Resolution zone hardware_covers method='removal'. SOP module description explicitly states masking discouraged.

weatherstrip_protection.evidence: TSK_DRRP_WEATHERSTRIP_PROTECT in MOD_DRRP_PROTECT. TSK_DRRP_WEATHERSTRIP_REINSTALL in MOD_DRRP_REINSTALL. Protection zone ext_weatherstrip_protect declared. Research RF-004 documents pull-out or deep-tape methods.

fiberglass_oil_prohibition.evidence: materials.json SYS_EXT_DRRP_PRIMER_ACRYLIC applies_when.substrate_material includes fiberglass — 100% acrylic. SYS_EXT_DRRP_PRIMER_STAINBLOCK has compatibility_warning: 'PROHIBITED on fiberglass doors.' SYS_EXT_DRRP_FINISH_ACRYLIC is 100% acrylic. Research RF-005 documents HARD BLOCKER.

steel_rust_debridement.evidence: TSK_DRRP_RUST_DEBRIDE in MOD_DRRP_PREP. applies_when substrate_material=steel, substrate_state_rules applies_when_input_state=SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST. SYS_EXT_DRRP_PRIMER_ZINC system for debrided steel. Research RF-006 documents SSPC-SP3/SP6.

lrv_ir_reflective_gate.evidence: materials.json SYS_EXT_DRRP_FINISH_IR_REFLECTIVE applies_when.color_lrv='<30'. Research RF-007 documents mandatory IR-reflective for LRV <30 on sun-exposed doors. Material swap (not additional product) is correctly modeled.

six_side_seal_wood.check: Six-side seal for wood doors present
six_side_seal_wood.evidence: TSK_DRRP_SIX_SIDE_SEAL_VERIFY in MOD_DRRP_PREP. applies_when substrate_material=wood. Research RF-008 documents manufacturer warranty requirement. SOP finish tasks quality_notes reference 'All six sides on wood' at QT5.

rrp_gate.evidence: MOD_DRRP_RRP applies_when pre_1978=true. 3 RRP tasks (containment setup, wet method prep, containment teardown). FAC_DRRP_RRP modifier values: none=1.00, tested_positive=2.00. PS_EXT_META.FLAG.PRE_1978 input declared.

ea_primary_uom.evidence: 38 of 51 tasks use EA. 12 tasks use FIXED (project-level tasks: mobilize, RRP containment, protection teardown, equipment clean, waste disposal, walkthrough). 1 task uses SF (TSK_DRRP_PROTECT_GROUND). No SF or LF on prep/prime/finish tasks.

condition_rrp_on_prep_only.check: Condition + RRP modifiers on prep tasks only

qt_on_coating_only.check: QT modifier on coating tasks only
qt_on_coating_only.evidence: FAC_DRRP_QT.applies_to_task_types=['prime', 'finish']. In COATING stacking pool. QT3=1.00, QT4=1.25, QT5=1.50.

worst_case_stacks.notes: 8.0x exceeds 4.0x flag threshold. Documented in both resolution.json and production.json with T&M pricing recommendation. This is an extreme edge case (grand entry + rust + lead paint) that is correctly flagged.

formula_check.notes: All factor modifiers use division formula. Consistent across resolution and production.

research_sections.notes: All mandatory research sections present. 15 relevant findings, 14 key decisions, 6 failure modes — comprehensive coverage of a complex 3-substrate spec.

protection_zones.notes: 6 protection zones covering all door-specific protection needs. Hardware removal as standard (not masking) is correctly modeled.

issues.description: SYS_EXT_DRRP_FINISH_ACRYLIC covers quality_tier [QT3, QT4] but is missing QT5. QT5 doors using standard colors (LRV >= 30) have no finish system defined — only SYS_EXT_DRRP_FINISH_IR_REFLECTIVE covers QT5, but that system is conditional on LRV <30.
issues.evidence: materials.json line 146: SYS_EXT_DRRP_FINISH_ACRYLIC quality_tier: ["QT3", "QT4"]. SYS_EXT_DRRP_FINISH_IR_REFLECTIVE quality_tier: ["QT3", "QT4", "QT5"] but is conditional on color_lrv <30. A QT5 door with LRV >= 30 has no finish material system.
issues.suggested_fix: Add QT5 to SYS_EXT_DRRP_FINISH_ACRYLIC quality_tier array. Add QT5-specific product tier (e.g., Sherwin-Williams Emerald Exterior, Benjamin Moore Aura Grand Entrance) under products_by_tier.QT5. Also add 'gloss' to allowed_sheens for QT5.

issues.description: research.json required_paintscope_keys includes 'PS_EXT_ASSET_EA.DOOR_HARDWARE' which does not appear in resolution.json or any downstream file. Resolution uses 'PS_EXT_PROTECT_EA.DOOR_HARDWARE' instead. The asset-namespace key is a phantom reference.
issues.evidence: research.json line 615: 'PS_EXT_ASSET_EA.DOOR_HARDWARE'. resolution.json paintscope_keys uses 'PS_EXT_PROTECT_EA.DOOR_HARDWARE'. SOP and production both reference the PROTECT variant. The ASSET key is not consumed anywhere downstream.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove 'PS_EXT_ASSET_EA.DOOR_HARDWARE' from research.json required_paintscope_keys. The PS_EXT_PROTECT_EA.DOOR_HARDWARE key in resolution.json is the correct canonical key for hardware removal scope.

issues.description: Worst-case modifier stacking reaches 8.0x (rust 2.0 x RRP 2.0 x grand_entry 2.0), which exceeds the 4.0x flag threshold by 2x. While this is correctly documented and flagged for T&M pricing, the estimation engine must implement the T&M gate to prevent this combination from producing unreliable estimates.
issues.evidence: production.json stacking_partition.max_theoretical_stacking.prep_worst_case: '8.00x — EXCEEDS 4.0x cap'. Same documented in resolution.json factor_modifiers.stacking_partition.
issues.suggested_fix: Ensure the estimation engine implements a hard flag when stacking exceeds 4.0x: output a T&M recommendation warning and mark the estimate as 'advisory only' for the affected tasks. This is an engine implementation concern, not a spec data issue.

issues.description: Resolution.json proposed 4 round configurations (ROUND_DRRP_SOUND_QT3, ROUND_DRRP_SOUND_QT45, ROUND_DRRP_FAILING, ROUND_DRRP_RUST). SOP expanded to 6 by splitting SOUND_QT45 into SOUND_QT4 + SOUND_QT5, and adding ROUND_DRRP_RESTORATION. The expansion is correct (better granularity), but represents deliberate drift from resolution.
issues.evidence: resolution.json round_configurations proposes 4 configs. sop_modules.json round_configurations has 6 configs: SOUND_QT3, SOUND_QT4, SOUND_QT5, FAILING, RUST_STEEL, RESTORATION.
issues.suggested_fix: No fix needed. SOP expansion from 4 to 6 round configs is a valid refinement. QT4 and QT5 have different interstage cycle counts (2 vs 3) justifying the split. Restoration config (QT5 + grand_entry + failing) is a useful explicit documentation of the extreme case. Document this drift as intentional.

EXT-1_key_namespace.notes: All paintscope_key references use PS_EXT_* namespace. No interior keys (PS_SURFACE_*, PS_EDGE_*) appear.

EXT-2_substrate_state_validity.notes: All valid_input_states use SS_EXT_* IDs (SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT, SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT, SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST). No SS_INT_* IDs present.

EXT-3_protection_zone_integrity.notes: Protection zones use ext_* prefix for new zones (ext_weatherstrip_protect, ext_threshold_protect, ext_siding_adjacent). Reused zones (hardware_covers, glass_mask, floor_workzone) are shared-domain IDs that are valid for exterior use.

EXT-4_site_condition_rules.notes: Environmental conditions (wind, surface_temperature, dew_point, sun_exposure) are documented in research.json site_condition_analysis.excluded_conditions with rationale: 'Not estimatable at bid time.' SOP tasks include site_condition_rules (exclude_when wind=high, dew_point_risk=unsafe) for process control. Per established exterior spec convention, these are SOP concerns not estimation modifiers.

EXT-5_exterior_factor_keys.notes: This spec uses FAC_DRRP_* modifiers rather than generic FAC_EXT_* because doors are ground-level with spec-specific dimensions. FAC_DRRP_CONDITION serves the role of FAC_EXT_SUBSTRATE_CONDITION. No FAC_EXT_ACCESS needed — doors are ground-level (ladder access is rare, documented in research but not modeled as a modifier).

EXT-6_modifier_math.notes: All modifiers use division formula: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier. Documented in production.json factor_modifiers[].notes and stacking_partition.formula.

EXT-7_material_state_compatibility.notes: Each material system declares substrate_states compatibility. SYS_EXT_DRRP_PRIMER_ZINC is SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST only (steel). SYS_EXT_DRRP_PRIMER_DTM is SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT + SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT (steel). SYS_EXT_DRRP_PRIMER_ACRYLIC covers wood + fiberglass for sound/failing. Complete substrate-state-to-primer routing.

task_inventory.notes: 51 tasks across 12 modules. Healthy distribution: 30 binary (fixed or conditional) + 5 qt_conditional (appear at higher tiers) + 16 qt_scaled (rate varies by QT). All tasks have skill_level assigned.

validation_verdict.overall_assessment: SF_DOOR_EXT_RP_v1 is a well-constructed spec with strong cross-file threading (51/51 task match, 0 classification mismatches, 0 UOM mismatches). The three-substrate-material branching architecture is cleanly implemented across all files. All doctrine constraints (fiberglass oil prohibition, steel rust debridement, hardware removal as standard, weatherstrip protection, six-side seal, LRV/IR gate, RRP gate) are properly enforced. The one substantive issue is the QT5 finish system gap in materials.json — this is a data omission that must be corrected before the spec can be used for QT5 estimation. The 8.0x stacking concern is correctly documented and flagged. No critical issues found.
